name: XSURGE
fix_description: calculatePrice uses address(this).balance / _totalSupply which can be manipulated within a single transaction. Attacker repeatedly purchases (inflating balance and price) then sells at inflated price. Fix: track internal balance separately from address(this).balance, or use time-weighted pricing that cannot be manipulated in one tx.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC is a multi-step flash-loan exploit involving PancakePair callback flow, repeated buy/reentry via the receive function, and multiple sell operations against protocol-specific token logic. It is not deeply complex, but it does require understanding the Surge token’s unusual transfer/receive behavior and the flash-swap repayment sequence, so it is beyond a trivial pattern.
